name: pear-os
description: PearOS Sequel — a parody of macOS 15, built with React and a Rust/WebAssembly kernel.

scripts.kernel: cargo build --manifest-path kernel/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp kernel/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pearnel.wasm src/kernel/pearnel.wasm
scripts.server: npm run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
scripts.server:static: npm run build && cd server && cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
